title: Workload-fingerprint intake + automated SLA recommendation pipeline for Dedicated
creator: Asha Rao
description:
Goal: Build an automated intake pipeline that translates customer workload signals into recommended Dedicated pool configurations and SLA targets. The output should be a prescriptive recommendation: GPU class, reserved throughput (tokens/sec or rps), burst policy, expected latency SLO bands, and a fallback plan. This recommendation will be surfaced to sales/solutions during intake and seeded into the Dedicated onboarding checklist.

Scope:
- Input: customer questionnaire + sample traffic (summary metrics) + deployment constraints (region, VPC, compliance).
- Core deliverable: a scoring engine (rule-based + lightweight ML fingerprint model) that outputs a 3-tier recommendation (Conservative / Balanced / Aggressive) and a numerical sizing suggestion.
- UI surface: a read-only recommendation in the intake tool for solutions engineering and a CSV export for capacity planning.

Non-goals:
- Full automated provisioning of Dedicated pools (this ticket outputs recommendations only).
- Deep per-customer performance tuning (left to a follow-up concierge flow).

Success metrics:
- 70% of enterprise intake use the recommendation as a starting point for sizing conversations.
- Reduction of average back-and-forth between sales and capacity team from 3 to 1.5 cycles.
- Recommendations within 20% of final committed GPU/reserved throughput in 60% of trials with early customers.

Outcomes & deliverables:
1) Intake questionnaire template and sample-traffic schema (Confluence link in comments).
2) Recommendation engine prototype (service + lightweight API).
3) CSV export and intake UI wireframe for preview.
4) Decision log and trade-offs doc for why certain kernels/GPU families are recommended.

Constraints & trade-offs considered:
- Conservatively favor reliability for regulated customers (prefer larger GPU family / more reserved throughput).
- For PLG-onramp customers with uncertain patterns, surface an Aggressive option but clearly label risk (preemption and warm-up latency).
- The fingerprint model will prioritize features that are cheap to compute from customer-provided samples (avg seq len, burstiness, steady throughput, embedding vs gen mix).
comments: 2026-03-05 - Kickoff meeting: agreed scope and deliverables. Attendees: Asha (PM), Marcus (PM lead), Leila (Solutions Eng), Omar (Infra), Priya (Data Science). Action: DS to produce initial fingerprint features list by 2026-03-09.

2026-03-08 - Data Science note: initial feature candidates: avg_tokens_per_request, 95p_seq_len, requests_per_minute, percent_streaming, long_tail_burstiness_index, model_family_preference. Posted feature spec: https://confluence.redwood.ai/dedicated/intake/fingerprint-spec (draft)

2026-03-09 - Decision: hybrid approach (rule-based baseline + ML reweighting). Rationale: allows immediate shipping with deterministic recommendations and later improvement as labeled outcomes arrive.

2026-03-10 - Engineering feasibility sync: ENG work needs an API (POST /intake/recommend) returning recommendation JSON, and a cron job to re-score customers weekly. Tentative ENG ticket: ENG-21543. Action: Marcus to open intake UI PR referencing design mocks.

2026-03-11 - Solutions Eng feedback: include explicit fallback ladder (model variant fallback, region fallback, soft-prefetching warm pools) and an estimated monthly cost delta for each recommendation tier. Leila provided a cost calc spreadsheet link.

2026-03-12 - PM review: acceptance criteria updated to include CSV export and handoff notes for Customer Success. Marcus assigned to produce a customer-facing one-pager for the concierge team by 2026-03-20.
Open question: how to weight business-critical customers who request stricter latency SLOs vs. cost-conscious customers? Proposed field in questionnaire: 'cost_sensitivity' with triage weight.
acceptance_criteria: Intake questionnaire finalized and published in Confluence
Recommendation engine prototype responding to sample payloads with Conservative/Balanced/Aggressive outputs
Intake UI presents the recommended tier, a numeric sizing estimate, and a CSV export for capacity planning
Decision log recorded for GPU family choices and fallback ladder
Early pilot run with 3 sales-led customers and quantitative feedback collected
rollout_plan: Phase 1 (Pilot): expose read-only recommendations to Solutions Eng for 3 customers (internal) - 2 weeks
Phase 2 (Beta): enable UI in intake tool for sales with prominent 'recommendation rationale' - 4 weeks
Phase 3 (GA): add weekly re-scoring and link into Dedicated onramp checklist, and instrument outcome telemetry for model retraining - 6 weeks
